scope: P1 synthetic isolated preview commit protection and immutable v2 cold recovery
remaining_limits: Factory-created rollback-journal reader exclusion only; WAL reader and COMMIT behavior separately observed
Time and disk I/O are not frozen by locks
Cooperative writer protection does not cover uncooperative owner direct SQL, missing/future rows, collections, dynamic registry or all sources
SNAPSHOT_MATCH is a comparison at read/sample time and does not imply current or atomic source validity

platform_notification: Parent reported prior turn interruption; current authorized local commands and windows worked, not counted as a test outcome
